newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rat poison kills child, sickens 60 in China - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rat poison kills child, sickens 60 in China - paper.

text.p: One child died and 60 people were in hospital in southern China after eating food tainted with rat poison, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Sunday.
Officials in the city of Guangzhou in Guangdong province were quoted by the Apple Daily as saying they were investigating the poisoning on Saturday.
The newspaper gave no further details.
Earlier this month a truck carrying 200 drums of cyanide plunged into a tributary of the Pearl River which flows through Guangdong. No deaths or illnesses were reported.
